description: Regression gate for the memory evaluation (docs/memory-eval.md): swift test checks the retrieval limits on every run, make eval-memory and the nightly memory-eval job check them and the answer limits. Retrieval is deterministic (recorded vectors, fixed now), so its limits are the 2026-10-08 baseline less about one or two questions per type; answer accuracy depends on the on-device model, which changes with OS updates, so its limits leave five to ten points. Answer limits apply only to the reader and judge they are keyed by.
